parameters.query:
=
WITH return_counts AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        COUNT(*) AS return_count
    FROM agentic_support.returns
    GROUP BY order_id
),

refund_counts AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        COUNT(*) AS refund_count
    FROM agentic_support.refunds
    GROUP BY order_id
),

exchange_counts AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        COUNT(*) AS exchange_count
    FROM agentic_support.exchanges
    WHERE status NOT IN ('rejected', 'cancelled')
    GROUP BY order_id
),

config_values AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN config_key = 'risk_score_escalate'
                THEN CAST(config_value AS BIGINT)
            END
        ) AS risk_score_escalate,

        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN config_key = 'serial_refund_threshold'
                THEN CAST(config_value AS BIGINT)
            END
        ) AS serial_refund_threshold

    FROM agentic_support.config
),

config_asof AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(config_value AS DATE) AS asof
    FROM agentic_support.config
    WHERE config_key = 'as_of_date'
)

SELECT
    o.order_id,
    o.customer_id,
    o.country,
    o.currency,
    o.item,
    o.sku,
    o.size,
    o.amount,
    o.status AS order_status,
    o.refunded,

    s.status AS ship_status,

    DATEDIFF(
        c.asof,
        s.delivered_date
    ) AS days_since_delivery,

    p.return_window_days,
    p.version AS policy_version,

    COALESCE(rc.return_count, 0) AS return_count,

    COALESCE(fc.refund_count, 0) AS refund_count,

    COALESCE(ec.exchange_count, 0) AS exchange_count,

    pr.category,

    cv.risk_score_escalate,

    cv.serial_refund_threshold

FROM agentic_support.orders o

LEFT JOIN agentic_support.shipments s
    ON s.order_id = o.order_id

JOIN agentic_support.policies p
    ON p.country = o.country

LEFT JOIN return_counts rc
    ON rc.order_id = o.order_id

LEFT JOIN refund_counts fc
    ON fc.order_id = o.order_id

LEFT JOIN exchange_counts ec
    ON ec.order_id = o.order_id

LEFT JOIN agentic_support.products pr
    ON pr.sku = o.sku

CROSS JOIN config_values cv

JOIN config_asof c
    ON 1 = 1

WHERE o.order_id = '{{ $json.order_id }}'
  AND o.customer_id = '{{ $json.customer_id }}';

=SELECT
    pr.sku,
    pr.name,
    pr.color,
    i.size,
    i.stock_quantity,

    CASE
        WHEN '{{ $('Execute a SQL query').item.json.country }}' = 'IN'
        THEN pr.price_inr
        ELSE pr.price_aed
    END AS price

FROM agentic_support.products pr

JOIN agentic_support.inventory i
    ON i.sku = pr.sku

WHERE
    i.stock_quantity > 0

    AND pr.category =
        '{{ $('Execute a SQL query').item.json.category }}'

    AND (
        CASE
            WHEN '{{ $('Execute a SQL query').item.json.country }}' = 'IN'
            THEN pr.price_inr
            ELSE pr.price_aed
        END
    ) <= {{ $('Execute a SQL query').item.json.amount }}

ORDER BY
    (pr.sku = '{{ $('Execute a SQL query').item.json.sku }}') DESC,
    price DESC

LIMIT 12;

=WITH params AS (
    SELECT
        '{{ $json.order_id }}' AS order_id,
        '{{ $json.customer_id }}' AS customer_id,
        COALESCE('{{ $json.desired_size || "" }}', '') AS desired_size,
        COALESCE('{{ $json.desired_color || "" }}', '') AS desired_color
),

return_counts AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        COUNT(*) AS return_count
    FROM agentic_support.returns
    GROUP BY order_id
),

refund_counts AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        COUNT(*) AS refund_count
    FROM agentic_support.refunds
    GROUP BY order_id
),

exchange_counts AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        COUNT(*) AS exchange_count
    FROM agentic_support.exchanges
    WHERE status NOT IN ('rejected', 'cancelled')
    GROUP BY order_id
),

config_values AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN config_key = 'risk_score_escalate'
                THEN CAST(config_value AS BIGINT)
            END
        ) AS risk_score_escalate,

        MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN config_key = 'serial_refund_threshold'
                THEN CAST(config_value AS BIGINT)
            END
        ) AS serial_refund_threshold

    FROM agentic_support.config
),

config_asof AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(config_value AS DATE) AS asof
    FROM agentic_support.config
    WHERE config_key = 'as_of_date'
),

order_details AS (
    SELECT
        pa.order_id AS order_id,
        pa.customer_id AS requested_customer_id,

        o.order_id AS matched_order_id,
        o.customer_id,

        o.country,
        o.currency,
        o.item,
        o.sku,
        o.size,
        o.amount,
        o.status AS order_status,
        o.refunded,

        s.status AS ship_status,

        DATEDIFF(
            c.asof,
            s.delivered_date
        ) AS days_since_delivery,

        p.return_window_days,
        p.version AS policy_version,

        COALESCE(rc.return_count, 0) AS return_count,
        COALESCE(fc.refund_count, 0) AS refund_count,
        COALESCE(ec.exchange_count, 0) AS exchange_count,

        pr.category,

        cv.risk_score_escalate,
        cv.serial_refund_threshold,

        pa.desired_size,
        pa.desired_color

    FROM params pa

    LEFT JOIN agentic_support.orders o
        ON o.order_id = pa.order_id
       AND o.customer_id = pa.customer_id

    LEFT JOIN agentic_support.shipments s
        ON s.order_id = o.order_id

    LEFT JOIN agentic_support.policies p
        ON p.country = o.country

    LEFT JOIN return_counts rc
        ON rc.order_id = o.order_id

    LEFT JOIN refund_counts fc
        ON fc.order_id = o.order_id

    LEFT JOIN exchange_counts ec
        ON ec.order_id = o.order_id

    LEFT JOIN agentic_support.products pr
        ON pr.sku = o.sku

    CROSS JOIN config_values cv

    CROSS JOIN config_asof c
),

eligibility AS (
    SELECT
        od.*,

        CAST(od.return_window_days AS INT)
        -
        COALESCE(CAST(od.days_since_delivery AS INT), 0)
        AS calculated_days_left,

        CASE
            WHEN od.order_id IS NULL
                THEN 'Order not found for this customer'

            WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(od.refunded, '')) = 'yes'
                 OR od.refund_count > 0
                THEN 'This order was already refunded'

            WHEN od.return_count > 0
                THEN 'A return is already in progress for this order'

            WHEN od.exchange_count > 0
                THEN 'An exchange is already in progress for this order'

            WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(od.order_status, '')) <> 'delivered'
                THEN 'The order has not been delivered yet, so it cannot be exchanged. Offer tracking, or a cancellation if it has not shipped'

            WHEN (
                CAST(od.return_window_days AS INT)
                -
                COALESCE(CAST(od.days_since_delivery AS INT), 0)
            ) < 0
                THEN CONCAT(
                    'Delivered ',
                    CAST(od.days_since_delivery AS STRING),
                    ' days ago; the exchange window is ',
                    CAST(od.return_window_days AS STRING),
                    ' days'
                )

            ELSE NULL
        END AS rejection_reason

    FROM order_details od
),

candidates_base AS (
    SELECT
        e.order_id,

        e.item AS original_item,
        e.sku AS original_sku,
        e.size AS original_size,
        e.amount AS original_amount,
        e.currency,
        e.country,
        e.category,

        e.desired_size,
        e.desired_color,

        p.sku AS candidate_sku,
        p.name AS candidate_item,
        i.size AS candidate_size,
        p.color AS candidate_color,
        p.category AS candidate_category,

        CASE
            WHEN e.country = 'IN'
                THEN p.price_inr
            ELSE p.price_aed
        END AS candidate_price,

        i.stock_quantity,

        CASE
            WHEN p.sku = e.sku THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS same_sku,

        CASE
            WHEN
                (
                    COALESCE(e.desired_size, '') = ''
                    OR LOWER(i.size) = LOWER(e.desired_size)
                )
                AND
                (
                    COALESCE(e.desired_color, '') = ''
                    OR LOWER(p.color) = LOWER(e.desired_color)
                )
            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS preference_match

    FROM eligibility e

    JOIN agentic_support.products p
        ON p.category = e.category

    JOIN agentic_support.inventory i
        ON i.sku = p.sku

    WHERE e.rejection_reason IS NULL

      AND COALESCE(i.stock_quantity, 0) > 0

      AND (
            CASE
                WHEN e.country = 'IN'
                    THEN p.price_inr
                ELSE p.price_aed
            END
          ) <= e.amount
),

preference_counts AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        SUM(preference_match) AS matching_preference_count
    FROM candidates_base
    GROUP BY order_id
),

selected_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        cb.*

    FROM candidates_base cb

    LEFT JOIN preference_counts pc
        ON pc.order_id = cb.order_id

    WHERE
        COALESCE(pc.matching_preference_count, 0) = 0
        OR cb.preference_match = 1
),

ranked_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        sc.*,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY sc.order_id
            ORDER BY
                sc.same_sku DESC,
                sc.candidate_price DESC,
                sc.candidate_size,
                sc.candidate_color
        ) AS option_rank

    FROM selected_candidates sc
),

options_aggregate AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,

        COUNT(*) AS option_count,

        CONCAT_WS(
            '\n',
            TRANSFORM(
                ARRAY_SORT(
                    COLLECT_LIST(
                        NAMED_STRUCT(
                            'rank', option_rank,

                            'line',
                            CONCAT(
                                CAST(option_rank AS STRING),
                                '. ',
                                candidate_item,
                                ' | Size: ',
                                candidate_size,
                                ' | Color: ',
                                COALESCE(candidate_color, 'N/A'),
                                ' | SKU: ',
                                candidate_sku,
                                ' | Price: ',
                                CAST(candidate_price AS STRING),
                                ' ',
                                currency,
                                ' | Credit: ',
                                CAST(
                                    original_amount - candidate_price
                                    AS STRING
                                ),
                                ' ',
                                currency
                            )
                        )
                    )
                ),
                x -> x.line
            )
        ) AS options

    FROM ranked_candidates

    WHERE option_rank <= 5

    GROUP BY order_id
)

SELECT
    e.order_id,

    e.requested_customer_id AS customer_id,

    CASE
        WHEN e.rejection_reason IS NOT NULL
            THEN FALSE

        WHEN COALESCE(oa.option_count, 0) = 0
            THEN FALSE

        ELSE TRUE
    END AS eligible,

    CASE
        WHEN e.rejection_reason IS NOT NULL
            THEN e.rejection_reason

        WHEN COALESCE(oa.option_count, 0) = 0
            THEN 'No matching exchange options are currently available'

        ELSE 'Eligible for exchange'
    END AS reason,

    e.item,
    e.size,
    e.sku,

    e.amount AS paid,
    e.currency,

    CASE
        WHEN e.rejection_reason LIKE 'Delivered %'
            THEN e.calculated_days_left

        WHEN e.rejection_reason IS NOT NULL
            THEN 0

        ELSE GREATEST(
            COALESCE(e.calculated_days_left, 0),
            0
        )
    END AS days_left,

    COALESCE(oa.option_count, 0) AS option_count,

    COALESCE(oa.options, '') AS options

FROM eligibility e

LEFT JOIN options_aggregate oa
    ON oa.order_id = e.order_id;
